name: LFQ_bout
description:
ABSTRACT
                We present an instrument-independent benchmarking procedure and software (LFQ_bout) for validation and comparative evaluation of the performance of LC-MS/MS and data processing workflows in bottom-up proteomics. It enables back-to-back comparison of common and emerging workflows, e.g. diaPASEF or ScanningSWATH, and evaluates the impact of arbitrary, inadequately documented settings or black-box data processing algorithms. The procedure enhances the overall performance and quantitative accuracy while enabling the detection of major error types.
evaluation_method: quantitative_accuracy (coefficient of variation, percent error, precision metrics)
general_score_metric: quantitative accuracy (CV, % error) and detection of systematic error types
reputation: A recent instrument-independent validation procedure/tool for LC-MS/MS workflows with growing interest among proteomics groups focused on benchmarking and QC.
notes: Not an ML/LLM benchmark — a proteomics benchmarking procedure and software; results are instrument- and protocol-dependent, so cross-lab comparability requires strict standardization.
